text:
marc-partnerships: Kickoff — Embedded Tracing Demo Kit for SI & HW partners. Goal: ship a Datadog + OTLP demo showing per-job GPU traces, latency spans, and model_version breadcrumbs. Owners wanted: sample app, dashboard template, quickstart, SI runbook. Target: partner workshop (pilot) by 1748007890 :rocket:

anya-product: +1. Scope to Dedicated + Private first. Add a short "how it works" diagram in the docs :eyes:

jess-eng-ml: I'll own the sample app. plan: OTLP exporter + tags (job_id, model_version, gpu_type). Posting sample config below.

jess-eng-ml: ```yaml
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317
    headers:
      "DD-API-KEY": "<DATADOG_KEY>"
service:
  name: redwood-inference
resource:
  attributes:
    cloud.provider: "aws"
    model.version: "v1.3"
```

kai-obs: I'll build a Datadog dashboard template: trace-analytics query like service:redwood-inference @gpu.type:V100, plus latency heatmap and top spans. Can we standardize span names: inference.request, kv.cache.hit, kernel.exec ?

marc-partnerships: @sophie-accelera can Accelera run the M3 pilot with Customer X? Need test dataset + infra details. Also confirm telemetry/legal ok.

sophie-accelera: Yes, we can. We'll need quickstart steps, OTLP auth troubleshooting, and a troubleshooting checklist. Add me to docs. :white_check_mark:

jess-eng-ml: Small runtime change: emit model.variant attribute on spans. I'll open PR in 3d.

anya-product: Add rollout plan: canary tile -> GA tile -> marketplace listing. Marketing will prepare co-auth blurb.

sam-sales: Adding channel team for co-branding. We'll sync on marketplace tile language.

deploy-bot: docs-bot created /partners/embedded-tracing-demo-kit.md

marc-partnerships: Actions: repo scaffold (jess), dashboard template (kai), quickstart (anya), SI runbook (sophie), legal check (sam). Target demo for partner workshop on 1748007890. Checkpoints: PR by 1748005001, dashboard draft by 1748006000.

jess-eng-ml: noted, opening PR now. :slightly_smiling_face:
